card.name: Gut-related warnings, next word predicted
card.fires_on: Small linking words, spaces or section numbers right around gastrointestinal warnings, mostly in triptan and opioid-constipation labels. It also fires partway through the drug name alvimopan.

modes.label: Linking word after gut term
modes.description: A word like 'and' or 'of' that follows or sits inside a gastrointestinal event phrase, where a gut word may come next.
modes.example: Gastrointestinal ischemic reactions<< and>> peripheral vasospastic reactions: Discontinue

modes.description: The word gastrointestinal inside a list of vascular ischemia reactions.

modes.label: Space before section number
modes.description: A blank gap before a warning section number such as 5.4 or 5.5 that cites a gut-related warning.
modes.example: Discontinue eletriptan hydrobromide tablets if occurs (<< >>5.5 ) • Medication over

card.writes: It pushes the model toward gut words such as gut, GI and enteric (including Chinese terms for intestine).
card.plain: It fires in label text about gut problems and helps predict that a gut-related word comes next.
